shared_elements: shallow incised/engraved linework on a dark stone surface
long curved arc or crescent-shaped band
worn, weathered object on a museum plinth
justification: Both are dark, weathered stone objects whose surfaces carry shallow engraved lines, and each includes a prominent long curved band arcing across the body, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge completely: A is a tall figural monolith with discrete, widely spaced relief motifs stacked vertically (discs, curved bands, ridged forms), while B is a rounded vessel covered edge to edge in dense, fine herringbone hatching with no discrete motifs or figural reference.
